answer: Entry to grading and voting requires a locked pearl of slashable collateral tied to a hardware-bound cipher that is unique for the epoch. Peers attest only the first use of that cipher; a reuse or a custody-graph collapse is treated as a clone and the deposit is burned in full. To field N puppets an attacker must buy a fresh jade-priced bond and a distinct hardware secret for each one, so sybil cost grows linearly instead of being a free copy of one key.
